measures.title: Tuscaloosa County: full-time municipal mayors in the Employees' Retirement System (Act 2026-377)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Tuscaloosa County. It would authorize the full-time mayors of municipalities in the county to participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama under the same terms and conditions as other employees in that retirement system.
measures.yesMeans: Full-time mayors of municipalities in Tuscaloosa County would be authorized to participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this authorization for full-time mayors is not added.
